checkpoints.description: [0/1] impact assessment recorded after the fact (the work landed as 120021e before this plan; no scope beyond it): promote the stdin buffer base, cursor index and count word into spare callee-saved homes for a leaf function that reads stdin

impact_assessment.why: ADR-077 established that the fused read_char path is bound by the memory read-modify-write on the static cursor, and the baselines keep the stream pointer in a register for the whole loop; char_stream is the largest recorded gap at 1.38x to C
impact_assessment.benefits: the hot path drops from nine instructions with a store-forwarding chain to a register compare, one SIB byte read and a register increment; every leaf stdin loop benefits, not just the benchmark; the count home removes one load per byte on top of the pair
impact_assessment.risks: contract: read_char's answers must not change (byte, -1 at EOF, repeated -1, one syscall per call at a true end), and the promoted registers must be saved and restored like slot homes, including the prologue parity math; dependency: none new, only three assembler encoders whose fixups end the instruction; concurrency: single-threaded; state: only functions that read stdin change bytes
impact_assessment.mitigation: falling-first shape tests for the triple, the two-spare pair, the no-spare fallback and the user-call refusal; the IR differential corpus and the four stdin end-to-end tests cover the contract; full-image SHA-256 against 420cd32; interleaved same-seconds A/B with a byte-identical control; the honest gate once the machine is quiet

checkpoints.description: [1/2] absolute-path measurement of gcc's mandelbrot inner loop and its division shape; [2/2] implement the cmov quotient form, verify it, and decide on evidence

impact_assessment.why: mandelbrot is the largest per-case gap to C (1.1x) and its inner loop divides by 2**20 every iteration, where gcc's cmov-shaped quotient looked one instruction and one cycle better
impact_assessment.benefits: a shorter quotient shape on every x / 2**k with an unknown sign, and a disassembly-backed account of where mandelbrot's time actually goes
impact_assessment.risks: contract: the quotient must stay exactly truncating for negative dividends, or the differential corpus and every twin catches it; dependency: none (lea_imm, cmov and test already exist); concurrency: none; state: emitted bytes change for every unknown-sign power-of-two quotient
impact_assessment.mitigation: falling-first shape tests for the cmov form, the wide-power fallback and the remainder chain; the IR differential corpus plus twin parity for semantics; the registry gate, a cycle-count microbenchmark with an identical-binary control, and an objdump comparison against gcc

checkpoints.description: [1/1] measured refusal, nothing shipped (ADR-081, 45a7eb0): the cmov quotient shape is four instructions against five but the same eighteen bytes, measures within the noise floor on mandelbrot (+0.4 percent cycle median, byte-identical control swinging 4.2 percent), and measures inside that same floor on a purpose-built division microbenchmark; the disassembly instead shows mandelbrot is about ten cycles per pixel with the inner loop rarely entered, so the cost is the per-pixel px * 16384 - 4194304 imul that gcc strength-reduces to an increment; code reverted, tests left unchanged; recorded next lever is loop induction-variable strength reduction; checklists: passed

checkpoints.description: [1/2] measure the ceiling of induction-variable strength reduction before building it: a hand-strength-reduced mandelbrot twin with the per-pixel imuls removed; [2/2] decide on the measurement and record the reframing

impact_assessment.why: ADR-081 recorded strength reduction as mandelbrot's next lever based on a disassembly difference, and building it is a substantial loop transformation whose value had not been measured
impact_assessment.benefits: a decisive ceiling measurement for a risky pass at the cost of one temp-dir twin, plus the workload shape (one inner iteration per pixel) that explains the case
impact_assessment.risks: contract: the hand twin must print the identical total and must be shown to have removed the imul, or the measurement proves nothing; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no compiler change
impact_assessment.mitigation: full-image byte inspection for the imul encoding in both builds, identical printed totals, and QueryProcessCycleTime over 21 paired runs
